Several of the modules in **`ramp.xds`** were included, in part, because they illustrated some feature of the code

+ `macdonald`  --- this is a system of delay differential equations. As written, the model can not handle exogenous forcing for mosquito surival and dispersal, including weather. We recommend using the generalized-Macdonald model **`GeM`**

+ [`basicM`](macdonald.qmd)  --- this is a system of delay differential equations. As written, the model can not handle exogenous forcing for mosquito surival and dispersal, including weather. We recommend using the generalized-Macdonald model **`GeM`**
